content.headline: What makes Vicwest practical for bigger roof work

items.title: Crew capacity when timing matters
items.body: Reviews describe two teams arriving for a Hamilton replacement and completing old roof removal, battens, sisal, new sheets, caps and flashings in one day on that job.

items.title: Plan-ready estimating
items.body: Vicwest uses CAD-trained estimators for new roofs and builder work, so plan sets can move into clearer takeoffs, pricing and scheduling conversations.

items.title: Fast outcomes on suitable jobs
items.body: Real customers mention same-day and two-day replacement outcomes. Your quote should still confirm timing against roof size, access, weather and materials.

items.title: Regional reach from Ballarat

content.headline: What customers notice after the roof is done
content.subhead: The strongest proof comes from homeowners describing the quote, the crew, the timing and the state of the site at handover.

items.quote: Replacing your roof is such an overwhelming thing but Hayden was amazing from first phone call to being on time with appointments, quotes (which was well below what we were expecting ) and getting the job done so quickly!! He and his team were wonderful making quick work of getting the old roof off and new one on and cleaning up as well and it looks unbelievable like a new house! I couldn’t recommend Vicwest Roofing enough!!!
items.author: Rebecca Schultz

items.quote: I was unable to get a roof replacement for 6 months in Hamilton. I saw Vic West add on Facebook so I gave them a call. Hayden promptly gave me quote and came straight away to measure up. Before I knew it 2 teams of trades were here and off with the old roof new battens and sisal new sheets on capped and flashed all in one day. Vic West are a professional team and I highly recommend.
items.author: Roland Peacock

items.quote: Hayden and his team replaced a rusting old iron roof on my old Creswick cottage with Colorbond ( Pale Eucalypt). Parts of the house were over 100 years old and it wasn’t an easy job. There were solar panels to be removed and replaced as well. The team did a great job, arriving very early each day and working solidly until knock off time. They ran a very tidy worksite and obviously took pride in workmanship, which was good to see. All the debris was removed at the end.
items.author: Helen Hanson
